summary: The same three arms as the dense NVLink campaign, three passes each, on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (AWQ, about 3B active parameters) in tensor parallel 2 under vLLM 0.29.0. The loss without the bridge's paths was about the same as for the dense model, slightly larger on batched throughput, so a sparse model does not let a pair skip the bridge; unlike the dense model, disabling NCCL peer-to-peer alone already cost some batched throughput. Still a software proxy: the bridge was never removed.
title: Does the NVLink bridge matter for a mixture-of-experts? Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
